name: rosetta-extensible-prime-generator
code:
use default

primes() -> Pipe[int] is
    let found = LIST[int]()
    let candidate mut = 2

    do
        let divisors =
            found |> take_while(prime => prime * prime <= candidate)

        if divisors |> all(prime => candidate % prime != 0) then
            found.add(candidate)

            yield candidate
        fi

        candidate = candidate + 1
    od
si

between(low: int, high: int) -> Pipe[int] =>
    primes()
        |> skip_while(prime => prime < low)
        |> take_while(prime => prime <= high)

write_line("the first twenty primes:")
write_line("  {primes() |> take(20) |> join(" ")}")

write_line("the primes between 100 and 150:")
write_line("  {between(100, 150) |> join(" ")}")

let band = between(7_700, 8_000) |> count()

write_line("primes between 7,700 and 8,000: {band}")

let ten_thousandth = primes() |> skip(9_999) |> first_or_throw()

write_line("the 10,000th prime: {ten_thousandth}")
